name: Outhouse
description: A small, wooden outhouse stands isolated in the snow,

environment.noise: surprisingly quiet, the sound of running water deep down the toilet

items.name: Stone tablet with Rune
items.description: A sturdy stone table with a glowing rune carved into its surface. It radiates a pleasant warmth, making the outhouse comfortable despite the cold outside.

items.name: Wooden Outhouse Seat
items.description: A worn wooden seat with a hole, from which sounds of running water echo deep below.

items.name: Wash Basin
items.description: A simple wooden wash basin filled with warm water.

exits.description: A wooden door to the outhouse
